title: How to Properly Refuse Risk

evidence.source_text: When an individual feels an assignment is unsafe...

nodes.text: Identify safe alternatives for completing the assignment

evidence.source_text: they also have the obligation to identify, to the degree possible, safe alternatives for completing that assignment.

nodes.text: Assess risks and ability to control them

evidence.source_text: The turn down of an assignment must be based on an assessment of risks and the ability of the individual or organization to control those risks.

nodes.text: Inform supervisor of turn down using Risk Management Process criteria

evidence.source_text: The individual directly informs their supervisor they are turning down the assignment as given...

nodes.text: Is there a violation of safe work practices, unsafe environmental conditions, lack of qualifications, or defective equipment?

evidence.source_text: Individuals may turn down an assignment as unsafe when...

nodes.text: Supervisor notifies Safety Officer or appropriate authority

evidence.source_text: The supervisor notifies the Safety Officer immediately...

nodes.text: If another resource is assigned, inform them of the turn down and reasons

evidence.source_text: If the supervisor asks another resource to perform the assignment...

nodes.text: Does an unresolved safety hazard exist or was an unsafe act committed?

evidence.source_text: If an unresolved safety hazard exists or an unsafe act was committed...

nodes.text: Document turn down with SAFENET or SAFECOM form

evidence.source_text: the individual should also document the turn down by submitting a SAFENET...
These actions do not stop an operation from being carried out...
